title: Chapter 1: Structure (features/01_structure)
description: Chapter 1 of the BotSpy docs: the basic structure of records — the session object, ordered messages, and walking through them — including the message/part anatomy (text, thinking, tool calls and results, attachments, provenance), the extra escape hatch, and the twelve pending schema extensions. Absorbs the old Layer 1 (unified session history) and Layer 2 (normalized schema) epics: their tasks live under this epic now.
right_now_summary: Core session schemas and tests pass, while metadata, role mapping, timestamps, and turn grouping still need work.
